context: Tests the pending-review race: checks pass and no thread exists yet, but Copilot is still an outstanding requested reviewer, so the agent must keep watching instead of merging during the review window.

checklist.name: Does not merge
checklist.description: No merge command or auto-merge action is taken while Copilot remains an outstanding requested reviewer

checklist.name: Pending review identified
checklist.description: The status identifies Copilot's pending review request as the blocker despite green checks and zero current threads

checklist.name: No false settled claim
checklist.description: The PR is not called ready, green, or settled merely because checks pass and the current thread list is empty

checklist.name: No forge noise
checklist.description: No filler comment, review reply, or other forge mutation is made while waiting for the requested review

checklist.name: Keeps watching
checklist.description: The next action is to continue observing, then re-read verdicts, comments, and threads after Copilot submits
